description: Use this when an owner has the six digit code Phorme sent to their place's own email or phone after they claimed it. Read the code back to the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. A right code makes the connected account the place's owner; a wrong one changes nothing, and after five wrong tries or 24 hours the place must be claimed again. It takes no payment. It needs a connected Phorme account.

code.description: The six digit code, as the owner gave it.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to entering this code.

name: verify_place_claim

place.description: The place: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, address, hours, about, book_url, request_email, request_phone (texts, never public), prices, phone, timezone, status (draft or live), page_url, upcoming_classes, brain_id, on_plan, held_requests and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link; null when on the plan).
